comments.body: What do we want to do about the batch size? Have it as another input for run_tasks? Add this as a Kwargs param? @borisarzentar @hajdul88

What do we get from this?
It will do things slower because it needs to wait for a document batch to finish in order to start a new one.

We can increase the size, but if we leave it unlimited if people try to handle 100-1000 docs in parallel we think Cognee will run out of RAM memory to work with. Probably better to define a customizable batch size
Maybe I would expose this as a parameter, maybe env? @borisarzentar ? But the default value, I would maybe increase but test. I also order the files based on size so that will help here.
### Bug: Function Name Mismatch Causes Error The `run_tasks_data_item` function is called as `_run_tasks_data_item`. This mismatch with the imported function name will cause a `NameError` at runtime.
